philippines.title: June Aster crew member dies, death toll rises to 77
philippines.description:
MANILA – The death toll in the fire that engulfed the MV June Aster off Coron, Palawan, has risen to 77 after a crew member who survived the incident initially died in a hospital, the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) said. In a statement on Wednesday, PCG spokesperson Commodore Noemie Cayabyab said the crew member was declared dead by the Culion Sanitarium and General Hospital at around 11:34 a.m. Tuesday. The number of survivors has since dropped to 43, while 12 individuals remain missing out of the 132 listed in the vessel’s ticket manifest. READ: Palawan ferry fire survivor dies from serious […]...

philippines.title: SC: Congress duty-bound to enact anti-political dynasty law
philippines.description:
MANILA – The Supreme Court (SC) has ordered Congress to fulfill its constitutional duty to enact a law prohibiting political dynasties “at the earliest opportunity.” The high tribunal issued the directive after, during its session last Aug. 26, it unanimously declared that Article II, Section 26 of the Constitution requires Congress to pass the anti-political dynasty law, and that failure to do so for 39 years constitutes grave abuse of discretion. In a statement on Wednesday, the SC said its en banc granted the consolidated petitions for certiorari and mandamus as the petitioners challenged Congress’ prolonged failure to pass a law […]...
